p='/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792544646/attempts/cb2a11620c414603a21132bf1f3c6a84/system/state/workspace/programs/task-1ec76d2e.py'; code='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = Counter(x for row in grid for x in row)
    bg = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    freq = Counter(x for row in grid for x in row if x != bg)
    marker = freq.most_common(1)[0][0]
    markers = [(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == marker]
    points = [(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] != bg and grid[r][c] != marker]
    r0,r1 = min(r for r,c in points), max(r for r,c in points)
    c0,c1 = min(c for r,c in points), max(c for r,c in points)
    ar, ac = (r0+r1)//2, (c0+c1)//2
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r,c in markers:
        for rr in range(r0,r1+1):
            for cc in range(c0,c1+1):
                y, x = r+rr-ar, c+cc-ac
                if 0 <= y < h and 0 <= x < w:
                    out[y][x] = grid[rr][cc]
    return out
'''; open(p,'w').write(code)
